description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted FIU Finance MCP service through an MCP stdio bundle for Hong Kong, US, A-share, Japan, IPO and bond market data; requires FIU_API_KEY and Node.js with npx.
description.zh: 通过 MCP stdio Bundle 接入托管的 FIU Finance MCP，提供港股、美股、A 股、日本、IPO 和债券等金融数据查询；需要配置 FIU_API_KEY，并安装 Node.js（npx）。
